{{Top|leg}}
The '''Delayan Whisperpines Hotel''' was a tall gray [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Leilani]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Delaya/Legends|Delaya]]. It was considered one of the most luxurious hotels on the planet, boasting [[Valet droid|autovalets]] and even a [[greenputt]] course.<ref name="hostage">''[[Rebel Force: Hostage]]''</ref>

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[X-7|Tobin Elad]] stayed at the hotel during Organa's [[Mission to Delaya|mission]] on the planet.<ref name="hostage" />
